purpose: Bind the official BI4 writer, loader, periodic transform, XML/Run.out inputs, and a future guarded native observation without inferring producer world orientation from field names or a manufactured fixture.

official_mapping.position: JPartDataBi4::AddPartData writes Pos (tfloat3) or Posd (tdouble3); JPartsLoad4 reads Pos/Posd into the simulation position buffer
official_mapping.velocity: JPartDataBi4::AddPartData writes Vel as tfloat3 and JPartsLoad4 reads it as velocity
official_mapping.density: JPartDataBi4::AddPartData writes Rhop as float and JPartsLoad4 reads it as density
official_mapping.constants: JPartDataBi4::ConfigCtes records Dp, H, B, Rhop0, Gamma, MassBound, MassFluid
official_mapping.domain: JPartDataBi4::ConfigSimMap records MapPosMin/MapPosMax; JPartsLoad4 consumes those limits
official_mapping.periodic: JPartDataBi4::ConfigSimPeri records PeriMode and PeriXinc/PeriYinc/PeriZinc; JSphCpu::Interaction_PosNoPeriodic applies increments at map limits
official_mapping.time: JPartDataBi4::AddPartInfo records TimeStep; XML/Run.out execution time is a separate source binding and must be joined by the guarded observer

position.authority: case geometry/source contract; BI4 serialization preserves the numeric component value

velocity.authority: XML/source position-update contract and BI4 Vel field; no unit conversion is inferred from a key name

mass.authority: MassBound/MassFluid source constants plus native header; particle sum is diagnostic only

time.authority: Run.out/RunPARTs and BI4 TimeStep joined by exact producer receipt

density.authority: Rhop0/source contract; not a world-axis claim

coordinate_scope.component_frame: BI4 Pos/Posd/Vel component order is source-defined x,y,z storage order
coordinate_scope.world_frame: UNKNOWN until actual producer XML/Run.out/source update and guarded native metadata agree
coordinate_scope.periodic_offset: MapPosMin/MapPosMax and Peri*inc are source-defined; only the explicit JSph periodic transform is admitted
coordinate_scope.axis_swap_or_sign_flip: must be rejected by asymmetric guarded calibration values

pre_registered_observation.scientific_task_tolerance: not assigned by this storage calibration

known_limit: ROOT217 proves official writer/decoder storage arithmetic for a manufactured fixture only; it does not establish historical producer world orientation or continuum-owner equivalence.
